name: Coach a skill practice
short_description: Observe three attempts, give targeted feedback, and adapt the next practice condition to the learner's performance.
self_assessment: I can coach three practice attempts without help and adapt each next attempt from observed evidence.
description: Observe three attempts, give targeted feedback, and adapt the next practice condition to the learner's performance. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Coach repeated practice of a short presentation
